terms.comment: A plain description: a book for school.

terms.gloss: a handbook of an art; a treatise
evidence: Cic. Fin. 4.5: nōn sōlum praecepta in artibus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A book that sets out the rules of an art, rhetoric and later grammar (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: ars
